steps: Push the monitor back to the wall (arm, 5.6 cm)
Slide the keyboard back under the monitor
Take the laptop out of the cubby, open it at the front, middle of the desk
Reverse of: Put the notebook away; Pull the keyboard and mouse forward; Pull the monitor forward (arm, 5.6 cm); Wake the laptop with the dock button
Nothing moves: turn the monitor off

Reverse of: Push the monitor back to the wall (arm, 5.6 cm); Slide the keyboard back under the monitor; Take the laptop out of the cubby, open it at the front, middle of the desk; Mouse stays on the right
Close the laptop, slide it into the cubby
Park the mouse under the monitor
Reverse of: Nothing moves: turn the monitor off
Pull the keyboard and mouse forward
Wake the laptop with the dock button
Reverse of: Close the laptop, slide it into the cubby; Park the mouse under the monitor; Open the notebook
